keyUnusable: That private key could not be used to sign. Check it is the .pem GitHub generated for the App, pasted whole, including the BEGIN and END lines. ({error})
multiInstall: Snoutbot is installed on more than one account, so it cannot tell which one to review as. Choose one in Settings.
noInstallToken: GitHub did not return an installation token for this App.
appCredsRejected: GitHub rejected the App's credentials. Check the App ID matches the private key, and that this computer's clock is right.
unknownAppId: GitHub does not know that App ID. Check it against the App's settings page.
notFound: {what} was not found. For a private repository the token also needs access to it, not just the right scopes.
githubTimeout: GitHub did not answer within {seconds} seconds. It may be slow, or your network may be holding the request.
gitlabTimeout: GitLab did not answer within {seconds} seconds. It may be slow, or your network may be holding the request.
tokenRejected: GitLab rejected the token while reading {what}. It may be expired or revoked.
tokenNotAllowed: The token is not allowed to read {what}. It needs the `api` scope.
gitlabNotFound: Could not find {what}. A private project also reads as missing to a token that cannot see it.
gitlabRateLimit: GitLab is rate limiting this token. {detail}
appNotSetUp: Snoutbot's GitHub App is not set up. Add its App ID and private key in Settings.
notAPrivateKey: That does not look like a private key. Choose the .pem GitHub generated for the App.
connectForge: Connect a GitHub or GitLab account first.
notARepo: That is not a repository. Try `owner/name` or the repository URL.
reviewGone: That review is no longer available.
noGitlabToken: No GitLab token is stored. Connect GitLab in Settings first.
noGithubToken: No GitHub token is stored. Connect GitHub in Settings first.
